title: ID0450702-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P8 170000829]-UI misinformation during cable check
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Multiple location and a frequently problem. After charging cable is connected to the car and RFID tag authentication done, charger asks user to reconnect the ccs cable simultaneously when cable check starts (DC contactor switching noise is coming from inside the charger). When cable check is done and session starts, charging window is shown like should.
Later this same happened different site.
Issue was in version 7.x.x and is still in version 8.0.5.
EcoG timestamps does not match??
Car connected
Thu, 18 Sep 2025 08:30:36 GMT
2025-09-18, 08:30:36
2025-09-18T08:30:36.237114+00:00 [FW080005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4322] [DCC] DC1: PilotState "A" --> "B2"
Session started
Thu, 18 Sep 2025 08:30:57 GMT
2025-09-18, 08:30:57
2025-09-18T08:30:57.880046+00:00 [FW080005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4322] [DCC] DC1: Charging Phase "P05_START_CHARGE" --> "P06_CHARGE"
Solution: It will be address in a later version
